header.name: Dispatch Functions
header.description: System flow to load and unload distribution groups to and from workunits

nodes.name: Mutate: Create Production Setup Output/ Production Setup Bom

data.query:
query ProductionSetupOutput(
  $where: ProductionSetupOutputWhereInput
  $whereDependency: WorkOrderProcessDistributionDependencyWhereInput
) {
  productionSetupOutput(where: $where) {
    edges {
      node {
        id
        unitPerCycle
        produced
        quantity
        scrapped
        setBatch
        standardPackQuantity
        virtual
        customData
        integrationData
        productionData
        workunitId
        workOrderProcessId
        workOrderProcessDistributionId
        workOrderProcessDistribution {
          id
          dispatchSequence
          unitPerCycle
          balanceQuantity
          producedQuantity
          productionOperators
          quantity
          setupOperators
          active
          extWorkunit
          group
          name
          actualFinishAt
          actualStartAt
          scheduledFinishAt
          scheduledStartAt
          customData
          integrationData
          cycleDuration
          idealDuration
          processDuration
          scheduledDuration
          setupDuration
          standardDuration
          transitAfter
          transitBefore
          distributionStatusId
          leadingDistributionId
          productionRunId
          workOrderProcessId
          workunitId
        }
      }
    }
  }
  workOrderProcessDistributionDependency(where: $whereDependency) {
    edges {
      node {
        id
        childWorkOrderProcessDistributionId
        parentWorkOrderProcessDistributionId
      }
    }
  }
}

nodes.name: Mutate: Delete Output / Create New Distributions / Link Dependencies

data.mutation:
mutation DeleteProductionSetupOutput(
  $payloadDeleteOutput: [ProductionSetupOutputDeletePayloadInput!]!
  $payloadCreateDistribution: [WorkOrderProcessDistributionCreatePayloadInput!]!
  $payloadDependency: [WorkOrderProcessDistributionDependencyCreatePayloadInput!]!
  $payloadUpdateDistribution: [WorkOrderProcessDistributionUpdatePayloadInput!]!
  $payloadWU:[WorkunitUpdatePayloadInput!]!
) {
  deleteProductionSetupOutput(payload: $payloadDeleteOutput) {
    id
  }
  createWorkOrderProcessDistribution(payload: $payloadCreateDistribution) {
    id
    dispatchSequence
    unitPerCycle
    balanceQuantity
    producedQuantity
    productionOperators
    quantity
    setupOperators
    active
    extWorkunit
    group
    actualFinishAt
    actualStartAt
    scheduledFinishAt
    scheduledStartAt
    customData
    integrationData
    cycleDuration
    idealDuration
    processDuration
    scheduledDuration
    setupDuration
    standardDuration
    transitAfter
    transitBefore
    distributionStatusId
    leadingDistributionId
    workOrderProcessId
    workunitId
  }
  createWorkOrderProcessDistributionDependency(payload: $payloadDependency) {
    id
    childWorkOrderProcessDistributionId
    parentWorkOrderProcessDistributionId
  }
  updateWorkOrderProcessDistribution(payload: $payloadUpdateDistribution) {
    id
    dispatchSequence
    distributionStatusId
  }
  updateWorkunit(payload : $payloadWU){
    id
  }
}
